title: Filtering diagram sheet
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Dissolving, separating and plants (Do All Solids Dissolve? and Allotment)
source: Seeded from science/y5 lesson 33 (Filtering diagram sheet (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 33: Separating mixtures: sieving and filtering. To understand how sieving and filtering separate solids from mixtures

picture.draw: Draw and label: Filtering diagram sheet

questions.q: How would you separate paper clips from sand?
questions.model: Ask what is different about them. Paper clips are steel: magnetic. Sand is not. A magnet pulls out the clips. A sieve would also work because the clips are bigger.

questions.q: In filtering, what is the residue?
questions.a: The solid left in the filter

questions.q: Can you filter salt out of salt water?
Filter a sand and water mixture with a coffee filter. Draw and label the funnel, filter, residue and filtrate.
questions.a: Labelled diagram; sand stays as residue, clearer water as filtrate
questions.model: Teacher sets up the funnel and filter on camera and labels 'residue: sand' as it builds up.

questions.q: Choose the best method for: rice and flour; peas and water; salt and water.
questions.a: Sieve; sieve or colander; evaporate (not filter)

questions.q: Why do water treatment works filter water through sand and gravel?
questions.a: To trap insoluble bits so the water is cleaner before further treatment

questions.q: The liquid that passes through a filter is the...
Big question: how would you get rice out of sand?
questions.a: Sieve it: sand falls through, rice stays.
